languageSelect.title: Choose your language
languageSelect.subtitle: You can change this anytime from Profile.

weather.title: Weather
weather.alertBody: Light to moderate rain expected in the next 24 hours. Plan field activities accordingly.

agriMart.title: Agri Mart
agriMart.body: Seeds, fertilizers, pesticides, and equipment for purchase will appear here once the store catalog is connected.

cart.title: Cart & Checkout
cart.body: Items you add from Agri Mart will appear here, ready for UPI or card checkout.

labourServices.title: Labour Services
labourServices.body: Find and book farm labour, or post a labour requirement, once this service is connected.

farmServices.title: Farm Services
farmServices.body: Tractor rental, drone spraying, soil testing, and transport bookings will appear here once services are connected.

governmentSchemes.title: Government Schemes
governmentSchemes.body: Central and state farmer schemes, with eligibility and application steps, will appear here once scheme data is connected.

cropAdvisory.title: Crop Advisory
cropAdvisory.body: Take a photo of your crop to diagnose issues and get treatment guidance once diagnosis is connected.

farmManagement.title: Farm Management
farmManagement.body: Track your fields, crop plans, and harvest records here once farm records are connected.

profile.title: Profile
profile.body: Your orders, bookings, advisory history, and settings will appear here once your account is connected.

aiAssistant.title: AI Assistant
aiAssistant.greeting: Hello! I am your Annadata 360 Assistant. Ask me about crops, weather, market prices, government schemes, or any farming query.
suggestions: What is the best time to sow rice?
